subject: Physics
question: Mars has mass 6.42 × 10²³ kg and radius 3.39 × 10⁶ m. Calculate the gravitational field strength at its surface. (G = 6.67 × 10⁻¹¹ N m² kg⁻²)
response_text:
Given: M = 6.24 × 10²³ kg, R = 3.39 × 10⁶ m, G = 6.67 × 10⁻¹¹ N m² kg⁻².

g = GM/R² = (6.67 × 10⁻¹¹ × 6.24 × 10²³) / (3.39 × 10⁶)² = 3.62 N kg⁻¹

So an object on the surface of Mars weighs 3.62 N for every kilogram of its mass.
